description: This file defines the AppManager class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class as a plugin component that manages application lifecycle notifications, interfaces with other components via JSONRPC, and handles remote connection notifications. It also includes nested Notification class for event handling and maintains internal state and references to other interfaces.

classes.name: AppManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing application lifecycle notifications, interfacing with other components, and handling remote connection events.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class within AppManager that implements remote connection and app manager notifications, forwarding events and logging activities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the AppManager plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the AppManager plugin, cleaning up resources.
